name: blog_outline_grounded
setup_turns: Jot this down: RelayDB is a database. Facts: multi-region by default, 9ms p50 reads, SQL-compatible, one CLI command to set up.
build_turn: Generate a blog outline from the scratchpad.
wellformed_criteria: The output is an OUTLINE, not a finished post: a working title, a short lede, 3-6 section headings each with a bullet or two, and a closing beat. It is not prose paragraphs end to end.

name: social_post_grounded

name: marketing_campaign_grounded
